result:
Root cause was in `strip_reminders` in `anthrouter/request_text.py`. Its docstring promises to trim outer whitespace, but it didn't. After the reminder block was removed, the newline stayed in front of the text, so `startswith(ACTIVITY_LABEL_PREFIX)` failed.

I added `.strip()` to its return value. Every caller of `strip_reminders` now gets trimmed text, not just `is_activity_label_prompt`.

I checked your example: `is_activity_label_prompt` now returns `True`. I couldn't run the test suite, because `pytest` isn't installed and `make test` needs a `python` binary that isn't on the PATH. I haven't checked whether other callers or existing tests relied on the untrimmed output.
